content.text:
Everything is committed. The branch now has two clean commits on top of main:

- `359b8809` — foundational Cloudflare seams + `deploy-cloudflare` package (workers, DOs, workflows, Hono adapter, wrangler.toml, etc.)
- `02b38727` — all 25 route files migrated to the `Handler` shape, full `ActorContext` discriminated union, `expressHandler` adapter, R2 storage services, sidecar client

The only remaining untracked items are `.serena/` and `.specstory/` which are tooling directories and should stay out of git.

The `feat/cloudflare-deployment` branch is clean and fully committed. The remaining genuine TODOs (tagged `TODO(cloudflare):` in the code) are the intentionally deferred pieces: multer file uploads → R2 multipart, SSE plugin bridge → Workers SSE, plugin process model → sidecar, and rawBody HMAC in routines.
